s.note: Charred green chilli and avocado mashed with lime and coriander, warm corn chips. Glows a little
s.how: Char 2 long green chillies over a gas flame or under the grill until blackened, peel, seed and chop. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes and 1 tsp salt. Fold in the chilli, half a finely diced red onion and a handful of chopped coriander. Press cling wrap on the surface until serving so it stays green. Serve with 300g warm corn chips.

s.note: Split mini bagels, red sauce, bubbling mozzarella and pepperoni. Nobody stops at one
s.how: Split 6 mini bagels. Spread each half with pizza sauce (150ml in total), top with 150g grated mozzarella and 80g pepperoni and grill for 5 minutes until bubbling.

m.note: Thin crust, tomato, mozzarella, pepperoni, fresh pineapple and jalapeño. How Keno got in the door at April's
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough thin on an oiled tray. Spread with 200ml pizza sauce, scatter 250g grated mozzarella, 100g pepperoni, 200g fresh pineapple in small pieces and 1 thinly sliced jalapeño. Bake at the oven's highest setting for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges char.

w.note: Buttermilk doughnuts fried golden, dipped in a sharp lime glaze. The bait for Tokka and Rahzar
w.how: Whisk 300g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp bicarb soda, 100g caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Beat in 200ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 40g melted butter to a soft dough. Pat out 1.5cm thick on a floured bench and cut 12 rings. Fry in 1L vegetable oil at 175C, 2 minutes a side, and drain. Mix 200g icing sugar with the zest and juice of 2 limes, dip the warm doughnuts and let the glaze set.

d.n: Ooze canister lime and kiwi slushie
d.note: Kiwifruit, lime and honey blitzed with ice and lemonade. A safe batch
d.how: Peel and chop 4 kiwifruit. Blend with 60ml lime juice, 2 tbsp honey and 4 cups ice until slushy. Add 400ml cold lemonade and pulse twice. Pour into 4 glasses with a lime wheel and thick straws.
